controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:22.000Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
| STATS count = COUNT(*)
        BY falco.output_fields.container.name
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20
